notes: Read all 120 numbered source lines before editing. Ported the module doc (L1-11), the HeroStatus union 'healthy'|'degraded'|'unhealthy'|'unknown'|'maintenance' (L19), the STATUS_CONFIG map (L21-34) as a native StatusVisual record, the StatusHeroProps interface incl. headline/subline/live/cta{label,onClick,loading}/id/className (L36-49), and the component body cfg/heading lookup + render tree (L51-120).

Resolved Tailwind/CSS-var tokens to literal values preserving visual intent: text-{c}-400 icon+heading (green #4ade80 / amber #fbbf24 / red #f87171 / zinc #a1a1aa / blue #60a5fa); ring-{c}-500/40 border + bg-{c}-500/15 ring tint; glowRgba -> native shadowColor {c}-500 hex + shadowOpacity 0.35 (zinc/unknown 0.25); h-14 w-14->56, h-7 w-7->28, ring-2->borderWidth 2, rounded-full->RING_SIZE/2; p-4->16; text-xl font-bold->fontSize 20/weight 700; text-sm subline->14 text-secondary; text-xs uppercase tracking-wider Live label->12/letterSpacing 0.8/textTransform uppercase/text-muted; gap-4->16, gap-1.5->6, space-y-2->8.

Replaced lucide-react CheckCircle/AlertTriangle/XCircle/HelpCircle/Wrench/RefreshCw with React Native View-drawn glyphs (no react-native-svg/vector-icons here, matching the LiveIndicator + BackgroundWorkSegment ports): outline circle + CSS-checkmark/cross/'?'-hook marks for check/x/help, a filled border-trick triangle + dark exclamation for alert, a diagonal handle + open-'[' jaw for wrench, and an outline ring + two arrowheads for the CTA refresh; glyph kind stored as a string discriminator instead of a component reference.

Web shared <Button variant=primary size=md> with icon+label has no native equal (AppButton takes only a string label), so an inline StatusHeroCta Pressable mirrors AppButton's primary skin (accent bg, minHeight 44, radius 14, paddingX 20, pressed/disabled opacity) and renders the spinning RefreshGlyph; cta.onClick preserved as the prop name and wired to onPress, disabled={cta.loading} preserved, and animate-spin reproduced via Animated loop (Easing.linear, 800ms) honoring AccessibilityInfo reduce-motion.

DOM/cn/i18n mapping: <GlassPanel>/<div>/<h2>/<span> -> native GlassPanel/View/AppText, cn() class-merge -> StyleSheet + style arrays, boxShadow glow -> shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius+elevation, id -> panel nativeID/testID; role=status aria-live=polite -> accessibilityLiveRegion=polite (RN has no 'status' role), icon-ring aria-hidden -> accessibilityElementsHidden+importantForAccessibility. <LiveIndicator variant=dot> reuses the ported native LiveIndicator; subline ReactNode is wrapped in AppText when it is a bare string/number so RN does not throw on a raw text child. Hardcoded English strings ('All systems operational'/'Degraded performance'/'Service outage'/'Status unknown'/'Scheduled maintenance'/'Live') preserved verbatim since the web source uses no i18n. No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components imported.
